name: Closure
overview: Scripture reveals that true closure is found in the perfect and restoring law of the LORD, which converts the soul and imparts wisdom to the simple (Psalms 19:7). Jesus affirms that life depends not merely on physical sustenance but on every word from God's mouth, emphasizing the enduring authority and fulfillment of God's law (Matthew 4:4; 5:18). Ultimately, closure is exemplified in Christ's finished work on the cross, where He declared 'It is finished,' securing eternal life for all who believe in Him (John 19:30; 3:16). This divine completion brings spiritual restoration and confidence in God's unchanging promises.
